# Social Media Graphic Design Skill for Muse

Platform-calibrated social visuals: exact pixel dimensions and aspect ratios for Instagram, X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Pinterest, and TikTok — plus the safe zones where each platform's UI eats your content (story top/bottom margins, reel caption zones, feed edge padding, profile-grid crops). It ships ready template structures for quote posts, LinkedIn announcements, multi-slide tip carousels, before/after posts, and stat graphics, with hard engagement rules (six words max per line, minimum font sizes, legibility at phone-feed size) and platform-specific design trends. Default output is a Gemini-generated PNG cropped to exact pixels with text kept in the safe zone; an HTML/CSS path handles templated carousels and copy-heavy posts, with a render-to-PNG loop and a read-the-PNG spell-check quality step. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: it references sibling skills in the same repo (ad-creative, banner, thumbnail design) but its core is self-contained; you need an image-generation model (Gemini 3.1 Flash by default) or HTML rendering — and platforms redesign often, so sanity-check dimensions before a big campaign. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
